asset.title: Zero-Click Content Machine
asset.description: Turn one topic into seven ready-to-post pieces — zero editing.

faq.question: What exactly do I get?
faq.answer: 10 copy-paste prompts that turn a single topic into a LinkedIn carousel, a Twitter thread, a newsletter and more — delivered instantly as Markdown, PDF and DOCX.

faq.question: Do I need a paid ChatGPT plan?
faq.answer: No. Every prompt is written to work on the free tiers of ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

faq.question: How fast do I get access?
faq.answer: Immediately. The download links appear on this page the second you check out — there is no waiting and no email confirmation step.

faq.question: Do I need any technical or writing skill?
faq.answer: None. Paste a prompt into your AI tool and swap the bracketed placeholders for your topic. If you can copy and paste, you can use this.

faq.question: Can I use the output for client work?
faq.answer: Yes. Everything you generate is yours to use for your own business or for clients. The only limit is that you may not resell the pack itself.

faq.question: What if it does not work for my niche?
faq.answer: The prompts are niche-agnostic by design — you supply the topic. If it genuinely is not a fit, reply on the product page and we will make it right.
